rawContent:
Tweet by @paulg (Paul Graham)
Author bio: 
Text: One of my office hours today was with a founder from 2011. Company's still going, doing pretty well. I asked him to give some advice to the next group, from the current batch. He said the biggest test is your own psychology. Can you keep going despite all the obstacles you face?
